item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: Students in grades 9-12 that are looking to make changes to their schedule, please see Mrs. Marcellus in the Guidance Office to sign up for an appointment. Teams messages and drop in's will not be accepted at this time.

item.title: A message from Mr. Curtis:
item.description: Sign up for 'Yardbirds' continues this week for senior music students. Please see Mr. Curtis at lunch if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mr. Brookes:
item.description: There will be a brief meeting for any Grade 11 or 12 Student interested in running for Student Council President or VIce President tomorrow at lunch in Room 226.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Any students who are interested in receiving the sacraments this year, like baptism, first communion, first reconciliation, or confirmation, please see Mr. Vonesch in the chapel at lunch today. Thank you!

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok:
item.description: A reminder of the first high school girls soccer tryout tomorrow after school from 2:30-3:30. Please have your participation form filled out and come dressed for the weather. if you have any questions, please reach out to Mr. Kwok

item.title: A message from Mr. Longval
item.description: Tonight is our first night of football practice. All players must hand in participation forms to attend. Players will change on the stage. Practice goes from 2:30-4:30 this evening.
